test_std_exception: test that throwing a standard C++ exception from pybind11 raises a Python RuntimeError
test_cross_module_exceptions: test that exceptions thrown across pybind11 modules propagate correctly as Python exceptions
test_custom_exception: test custom pybind11 exception types like MyException and their translation to Python
test_nested_throws: test nested C++ to Python to C++ exception handling with try_catch
test_python_alreadyset_in_destructor: test that Python errors already set during C++ destructor execution are handled correctly
